title: Central Tire Inflation System (CTIS) Leak Diagnostics
description: Intermediate technical English module analyzing central tire inflation system (ctis) leak diagnostics.
learning_objectives: Master professional First & Second Conditionals (If/When) in automotive engineering
Eliminate common Czech interference errors in central tire inflation system (ctis) leak diagnostics
Demonstrate precision in technical and regulatory documentation

questions.prompt: If the CTIS air compressor _____ pressure above 8 bar within five minutes, the ECU flags an air leak warning.

explanations.correct: First conditional if-clause takes Present Simple ('fails to maintain') for real operational consequences.
explanations.wrong_A: Cannot use 'will' in the conditional if-clause.
explanations.wrong_C: Cannot use 'would' in a real First Conditional if-clause.
explanations.wrong_D: Past tense produces an unreal condition, mismatched with present 'flags'.

questions.cz_learning_point: Czenglish trap: Never put 'will' into the if-clause (*If the compressor will fail*). Use Present Simple: 'If the compressor fails'.
